rev.t:
Please don't arrange any event here.

We had pre-engagement here. Hall was good but the food vendor they organized was so bad that it left a bad impression of us among the bride's side.

We were referred to The Majesstine Sports by a friend for our daughter’s 5th birthday party, and the experience was wonderful. From the initial consultation to the event day, Shweta was incredibly supportive and addressed all our concerns. …

We had our baby’s first birthday party here. Ambiance of the banquet hall is amazing and the kids area next to it is just perfect. I felt the charges are reasonable and even the management is polite and friendly. We were little worried …
